Do you still remember the first time you backed the car out of the driveway by yourself? That feeling was pure freedom. But for your parents, that moment might have been one of the scariest of their lives. When you were a teenager, they had absolutely no way of knowing whether you were speeding, where you had gone, when you would arrive, or how safely you were driving. "No news is good news," they could only hope for the best until you checked in.

If you currently have a teenager who drives, you should truly appreciate that you no longer live in that age of constant worry. Although technology in 2026 has its share of shortcomings, HeyPolo is clearly an example of technology making teenage driving safer and life overall better.

HeyPolo is more than just an upgraded version of Apple's "Find My" service

HeyPolo is a family safety application that bundles real-time location sharing, arrival and departure notifications, SOS emergency alerts, and driving safety features all into one price. The driving features are what set it apart most from ordinary location-sharing apps (such as "Find My"). Every time your kids get behind the wheel, their driving behaviour will be tracked and scored, so you can clearly see how they are performing: how fast they are going, whether they used their phone while driving, whether there was any hard braking or sudden acceleration, and whether any serious driving incidents were detected.

The "driving score" rates each trip according to their real driving behaviour, so you no longer have to guess whether your teenager is actually driving safely. You can look at the data, have a serious conversation if the driving is poor, and as their driving habits improve, the score will gradually rise. Compared with any tool available to the previous generation, this is far more useful for helping newly licensed drivers build their skills.

Collision detection, arrival notifications, and more

HeyPolo can detect a collision and automatically notify you. Combined with arrival alerts — whether your kids have reached school, the practice field, a friend's home, or made it back home, the system will send a triggered notification — you can move from "hoping no news is good news" to actually knowing whether they are safe. You don't have to wait for them to arrive before you text or call them; you can know precisely when they get there, and that peace of mind is priceless for parents. HeyPolo updates the location every 5 seconds, so your location information is always accurate.

One price, shared by the whole family

A single HeyPolo subscription already covers your entire family, with absolutely no extra per-person charges. It works on both iPhone and Android, so families using a mix of devices don't need to stress about it. HeyPolo is developed by the team behind Surfshark, so it has a solid privacy foundation. They won't sell your data; you control what you share, who you share it with, and when you stop sharing, and all data is automatically deleted every 7 days. For a location-based application, this is essential when it comes to privacy.

HeyPolo offers a 30-day money-back guarantee, with no contract required — there's simply no reason not to give it a try.
